sa: न तत् पूर्वे जनाचक्रुर्न करिष्यन्ति चापरे। गयो यदकरोद् यज्ञे राजर्षिरमितद्युतिः॥
en: What the immeasurably effulgent royal sage Gaya has done was never done by any man before or will be done by any man in future.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एष ह्येषां समस्तानां तेजोवलपराक्रमः। मध्ये तपन्निवाभाति ज्योतिषामिव भास्करः॥
en: Bhishma said As sun shines among all luminous objects, so shines this (Krishna) among all (these kings and potentates) by his effulgence, strength and prowess.

sa: अनिशायां निशायां च सहा या क्षुत्पिपासयोः। आराधयन्त्याः कौरव्यांस्तुल्या रात्रिरहश्च मे॥
en: Day and night bearing hunger and thirst, I used to wait upon the Kuru princes, so that my nights and days were equal to me.

sa: शाकैर्मूलैः फलैर्वापि येन वर्तयते स्वयम्। तद् वै दद्याद् ब्राह्मणाय श्रद्धावाननसूयकः॥
en: He, who supports himself on vegetables, roots and fruits, may very well offer such food to the Brahmanas with due regard and without any disrespect.

sa: आदातुं च नरव्याघ्रो यं यमिच्छत्ययं तदा। तस्य विप्लवते बुद्धिरेवं चेदिपतेर्यथा॥
en: The intelligence of all men whom this best of men (Krishna) desires to take to himself become as perverse as that of this Chedi king.

sa: भुक्तमेतेन बह्वन्नं क्रीडता नगमूर्धनि। इति ते भीष्म शृण्वानाः परे विस्मयमागताः॥
en: O Bhishma, "while sporting on the hills, this one ate a large quantity of food,” hearing these words of yours, many have been much astonished.

sa: न ते श्रुतमिदं भीष्म नूनं कथयतां सताम्। यद् वक्ष्ये त्वामधर्मज्ञं वाक्यं कुरुकुलाधम॥
en: O Bhishma, O wretch of the Puru race, you are ignorant of the precepts of religion. You have not heard from the pious men what I would now tell you.

sa: ममाद्याचक्ष्व पाञ्चालि यशस्यं भगदैवतम्। येन कृष्णे भवेन्नित्यं मम कृष्णो वशानुगः॥
en: Tell me, O Panchala princess, of that blessed and auspicious thing by which, O Krishna, (Draupadi) my husband (Krishna) may be ever obedient to me.”

sa: यथा पितुर्गृहे विप्र प्रासादे शयनं मम। तथाविधे त्वं शयने मामुपैतुमिहार्हसि॥
en: O Brahmana, you should come to me on a bed like the one in which I used to lie in my father's house, his palace.

sa: दरदं स्तुहि बाह्रीकमिमं पार्थिवसत्तमम्। जायमानेन येनेयमभवद् दारिता मही॥
en: Praise this best of kings Danda, the monarch of Valhika, who, as soon as he was born, rent this earth.

sa: पर्जन्यश्चाप्यनुययौ नमस्कृत्य पिनाकिनम्। छत्रं च पाण्डुरं सोमस्तस्य मूर्धन्यधारयत्॥
en: The clouds went along making their obeisance to the wielder of Pinaka. Soma held a white umbrella over his head.

sa: क्रोधाद् दण्डान्मनुष्येषु विविधान् पुरुषोऽनयात्। भ्रश्यते शीघ्रमैश्वर्यात् प्राणेभ्यः स्वजनादपि॥
en: A man, in anger, inflicts various punishments upon people and is soon deprived of his wealth, life and even kinsmen.

sa: यानं वस्त्राण्यलंकाराञ्छयनान्यासनानि च। भोजनान्यथ पानानि सर्वोपकरणानि च॥ आददीरनधिकृता यथाकाममचेतसः। प्रदिष्टानि च देयानि न दद्युभर्तृशासनात्॥ न चैनं भर्तृपूजाभिः पूजयन्ति कथंचन। अवज्ञानं हि लोकेऽस्मिन् मरणादपि गर्हितम्॥१२
en: Those vicious servants also appropriate to themselves nis conveyances, clothes ornaments, dress, beds, seats, food, drink and other articles of use. They do not at the behest of their master, give to others things they are commanded to do, Nor do they treat their master with that respect which is his due. Disregard in this world is worse than death.

sa: अप्रकीर्णेन्द्रियं दान्तं शुचिं नित्यमतन्द्रितम्। आस्तिकं श्रद्दधानं च वर्जयन्ति सदा ग्रहाः॥
en: Those evil spirits always avoid those who are self-controlled and self-restrained, who are of cleanly habits, who are god-fearing and free from laziness and contamination.

sa: यमाश्रित्य महाबाहुं पाञ्चालाः कुरवस्तथा। सुराणामपि मत्तानां पृतनासुन बिभ्यति॥
en: (Without him), relying on which mightyarmed hero the Panchalas and the Kurus do not fear even the various powerful celestials.

sa: करञ्जे तां नमस्यन्ति तस्मात् पुत्रार्थिनो नराः। इमे त्वष्टादशान्ये वै ग्रहा मांसमधुप्रियाः॥ द्विपञ्चरात्रं तिष्ठन्ति सततं सूतिकागृहे। कदूः सूक्ष्मवपुर्भूत्वा गर्भिणी प्रविशत्यथ॥ भुङ्क्ते सा तत्र तं गर्भं सा तु नागं प्रसूयते।
en: Those who desire to have children bow down to her who seats on Karanja tree. Those eighteen evil spirits, fond of meat and wine and also other food of the same kind, live for ten days in the lyings in room. Kadru assuming a subtle form enters into the womb of a woman. And she there destroys the fetus. The mother is thus made to give birth to a Naga.

sa: तथा लालप्यमानां तां निशम्य परवीरहा। भीमसेनो महाराज द्रौपदीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, hearing her thus lament, that slayer of hostile heroes Bhimasena, thus spoke to Draupadi.

sa: स्कन्दापस्मारमित्याहुर्चहं तं द्विजसत्तमाः। विनता तु महारौद्रा कथ्यते शकुनिग्रहः॥
en: Skandapasmara is the name by which it is known amongst the excellent Brahmanas, Vinata is called the fearful Sukani Graha.

sa: विशेषतस्तु पाञ्चाली स्मरन्ती मध्यमं पतिम्। उद्विग्नं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Panchali (Draupadi) in particular remembered her third husband and she thus spoke to the anxious chief of the Pandavas (Yudhishthira).

sa: सर्वे संन्यवसंस्तत्र सोत्कण्ठाः पुरुषर्षभाः। अहृष्टमनसः सर्वे गते राजन्धनंजये।॥
en: O king, after the departure of Dhananjaya (Arjuna) thus did they live there, filled with sorrow and with cheerless heart.

sa: अथ चैषा न ते बुद्धिः प्रकृतिं याति भारत। मयैव कथितं पूर्वं भूलिङ्गशकुनिर्यथा।॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, perhaps your inclination is not conformable to your true nature, like that of the bird Bhulinga, the story of which has been already told by me.

sa: आक्षिप्तसूत्रा मणयश्छिन्नपक्षा इव द्विजाः। अप्रीतमनसः सर्वे बभूवुरथ पाण्डवाः॥
en: The Pandavas all became depressed and looked like pearls unstrung from a garland or like birds shorn of their wings.

sa: युधिष्ठिर निबोधेदं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। भृगोस्तीर्थं महाराज महर्षिगणसेवितम्॥
en: O Yudhishthira, O great king, behold the Bhrigu Tirtha, celebrated over the three worlds and frequented by the great Rishi.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु भीष्मेण ततः संचक्रुशुर्नृपाः। केचिज्जहषिरे तत्र केचिद् भीष्मं जगहिरे॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed by Bhishma, the kings became full of anger. Some amongst them stood erect and some began to reproach Bhishma.

sa: केचिदूचुर्महेष्वासाः श्रुत्वा भीष्मस्य तद् वचः। पापोऽवलिप्तो वृद्धश्च नायं भीष्मोऽर्हति क्षमाम्॥
en: Having heard these words of Bhishma, some of these great bowmen said, “This sinful wretch, Bhishma, though old, is exceedingly boastful. He deserves no pardon.

sa: उपर्युपरि शैलस्य बह्वीश्च सरितः शिवाः। पृष्ठं हिमवतः पुण्यं ययौ सप्तदशेऽहनि॥
en: And many a sacred stream one above the other issuing from the mountain, he ascended the sacred plateau of the Himalayas on the seventeenth day.

sa: वयं चैतद् भारत सर्व एव त्वया जिताः कालमपास्य भोगान्। वसेम इत्याह पुरा स राजा मध्ये कुरूणां स मयोक्तस्तथेति॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, we also, if defeated by you at play, shall all of us, abandoning all our wealth, pass other same period according to the same rules." Thus said that king in the midst of the Kurus; and I said "So Be it."

sa: विषमावस्थिते दैवे पौरुषेऽफलतां गते। विषादयन्ति नात्मानं सत्त्वोपाश्रयिणो नराः॥
en: Reflecting on the caprice of fate and futileness of human exertions, men of selfpossession never allow themselves to be aggrieved.

sa: न्यष्ठीवदाकाशगतो महर्षेस्तस्य मूर्धनि। स कोपान्मामुवाचेदं दिशः सर्वा दहन्निव॥
en: Spat on the head of that great sage. He (Agastya) as if burning all the cardinal points with his anger,

sa: भीमसेनादिभिः सर्वैर्धातृभिः परिवारितः। पाञ्चाल्या ब्राह्मणाश्चैव न्यवसन्त सुखं तदा॥
en: He happily lived there surrounded by Bhimasena and his other brothers and also by the Panchala princess and the Brahmanas.

sa: प्रफुल्लैः कमलैश्चैव तथा नीलोत्पलैरपि। महापुण्यं पवित्रं च सुरासुरनिषेवितम्॥
en: And (bright) with blooming lilies and blue lilies; sacred, pure and frequented by the Suras (gods) and the Asuras (demons).

sa: तदैव चेद् वीर कर्माकरिष्यो यदा द्यूते परिघं पर्यमृक्षः। बाहू दिधक्षन् वारितः फाल्गुनेन किं दुष्कृतं भीम तदाभविष्यत्॥
en: O hero, you desired to burn my hand at the time of the play; you were, however, prevented by Arjuna and you only squeezed your mace. O Bhima, if you had done it, this calamity could not then befall us.

sa: तमुपायं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा वृत्रं वधिष्यथा दधीच इति विख्यातो महानृषिरुदारधीः॥ तं गत्वा सहिताः सर्वे वरं वै सम्प्रयाचत। स वो दास्यतिधर्मात्मा सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: I shall tell you the means by which Vritra will be killed. There is a highly intelligent great Rishi, well-known by the name of Dadhichi. Go to him all together and ask from him a boon. That Rishi, of virtuous mind and well pleased heart, will grant you the boon.

sa: स वाच्यः सहितैः सर्वैर्भवद्भिर्जयकाक्षिभिः । स्वान्यस्थीनि प्रयच्छेति त्रैलोक्यस्य हिताय वै॥
en: Desirous as you are of victory, go all together to him and tell him, "Give us your bones for the good of the three worlds."

sa: स्वाहा तं दक्षदुहिता प्रथमं कामयत् तदा। सा तस्य छिद्रमन्वैच्छच्चिरात्प्रभृति भाविनी॥
en: But a little while ago, Svaha, the daughter of Daksha, had bestowed her heart on him. That lady was seeking to detect his weak moments.

sa: इदं च शयनं दृष्ट्वा यच्चासीत् ते पुरातनम्। शोचामि त्वां महाराज दुःखान/ सुखोचितम्॥
en: O great king, seeing this your bed and recollecting what you had before I grieve for you, who do not deserve misery and have been brought up in every luxury.

sa: शरीरिणां हि मरणं शरीरे नित्यमाश्रितम्। प्रागेव मरणात् तस्माद् राज्यायैव घटामहे॥
en: Wealth is ever established in every creature having corporeal body. Therefore we should try to get possession of our kingdom before we meet with death.

sa: चकार वज्रं भृशमुचरूपं कृत्वा च शक्रं स उवाच हृष्टः। अनेन वज्रप्रवरेण देव भस्मीकुरुष्वाद्य सुरारिमुचम्॥
en: He made the Vajra of greatly fearful, appearance. Having made it he cheerfully said to Sakra (Indra), “O god, with this best of weapons Vajra reduce today the fearful enemies of the celestials to ashes.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच मम मातृष्वसेयी त्वं माता दाक्षायणी मम। आख्यातुं त्वहमिच्छामि स्वयमात्मबलं त्वया।॥
en: Indra said: You are one of my cousins, for your mother is a sister of my mother Dakshayani. I desire that you should speak to me about your own prowess.

sa: स चापि शक्रस्य समप्रभावो महानुभावः समरेष्वजेयः। विहाय भोगानचरद् वनेषु नेशे बलस्येति चरेदधर्मम्॥
en: He was equal to Shakra in prowess, highminded and invincible in warfare, still he had to range the forest, renouncing pleasure; therefore none should act unrighteously thinking "I am powerful."

sa: राज्ञस्तु वचनं स्मृत्वा धर्मपुत्रस्य धीमतः॥ क्रमेण मृदुना युद्धमुपक्रान्तं च भारत।
en: In accordance with the command of the greatly intelligent of Dharma, Yudhishthira, O descendant of Bharata, the battle that took place was but a skirmish.

sa: वध्यमानं बलं दृष्ट्वा बहुशस्तैः पुरंदरः। स सैन्यनायकार्थाय चिन्तामाप भृशं तदा॥
en: Findings his armies slaughtered by them and being eager to find out a Generalissimo for the celestials army Purandara (Indra) was filled with great anxiety.

sa: ततः स्वोरसि विन्यस्य वक्त्रं तस्य शुभानना। परीता तेन दुःखेन निशश्वासायतेक्षणा॥
en: Thereupon the lady, of beautiful face and of large eyes, hiding her face in his bosom, became overwhelmed with grief and began to sigh heavily.

sa: स्वरूपिणं तु भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा भीमसुता तदा। प्राक्रोशदुच्चैरालिङ्गय पुण्यश्लोकमनिन्दिता॥
en: Beholding her husband in his original form, the faultless daughter of king Bhima embraced the righteous one and wept bitterly.

sa: विष्णुरुवाच विदितं मे सुराः सर्वं प्रजानां क्षयकारणम्। भवतां चापि वक्ष्यामि शृणुध्वं विगतज्वराः॥
en: Vishnu said: O celestials, I know the reason of the destruction of all creatures. I shall tell you all about it. Having your mind freed form anxiety listen to it.

sa: घृणी ब्राह्मणरूपोऽसि कथं क्षत्रेऽभ्यजायथाः। अस्यां हि योनौ जायन्ते प्रायशः क्रूरबुद्धयः॥
en: You are kind as a Brahmana; how have you been born in the Kshatriya order? Those born in it (the Kshatriya order) are generally crooked-minded.

sa: अन्योन्यं समनुज्ञाप्य जग्मतुः स्वगृहान् प्रति। गते द्वारवती कृष्णे सात्वतप्रवरे नृप॥
en: Took each other's leave and went towards their respective homes. O king, when the foremost of the Satvata race, Krishna, had gone away to Dvaravati.

sa: अस्माभिरुषिताः सम्यग्वने मासास्त्रयोदश। परिमाणेन तान् पश्य तावतः परिवत्सरान्॥
en: We have already lived in the forest for full thirteen months. Consider them for their length as full thirteen years.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्यधर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। संस्मृत्य मुनिसंदेशमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥ विविक्ते विदितप्रज्ञमर्जुनं पुरुषर्षभ। सान्त्वपूर्वं स्मितं कृत्वा पाणिना परिसंस्पृशन्॥ स मुहूर्तमिवध्यात्वा वनवासमरिंदमः। धनंजयधर्मराजो रहसीदमुवाच॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After sometime, Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, remembering the words of the Muni (Vyasa), spoke these words. Calling to himself in private that foremost of men, the greatly wise Arjuna and taking hold of his hands. That chastiser of foes, Dharmaraja, reflecting for a moment over their exile, smilingly spoke these words to Dhananjaya (Arjuna).

sa: तदा तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मरणे निश्चिता मतिः। सर्वक्षत्रस्य निधने यद्यहं हेतुरीप्सितः॥
en: Hearing his words, my firm resolve is to die, when I have been ordained to be the cause of the destruction of all the Kshatriyas.

sa: कालेन निर्मितस्तात को ममार्थोऽस्ति जीवतः। एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानं फाल्गुनः प्रत्यभाषत।॥
en: O children, if Time has willed it, what need is there for me to live?” To the king who was thus speaking replied Falguni (Arjuna),

sa: यथा च भगवानग्निः स्वयमेवाङ्गिराऽभवत्। संतापयंश्च प्रभया नाशयस्तिमिराणि च॥
en: And why the exalted, Angirasa, transforming himself into Agni, destroyed all the darkness and distress (the world) by his splendour.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच कृतप्रज्ञोऽसि मेधावी बुद्धिर्हि विपुला तव। नाहं भवन्तं शोचामि ज्ञानतृप्तोऽसि धर्मवित्॥
en: The Brahmana said: You are wise great in knowledge and vast in your intelligence; O virtuous one, you are content with your wisdom. I have nothing to complain in you.

sa: आश्रमं च मया नीतो न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत। एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथा मम पुराभवत्॥ अभितश्चापि गन्तव्यं मया स्वर्गं द्विजोत्तम॥
en: I took him to the hermitage, but he was not deprived of his life, (he recovered from the । wound). I have thus narrated to you all that happened to me before. O foremost of men and also now I can go to heaven hereafter.

sa: ज्योतींषि चाप्यशेषेण सर्वाण्यनघ सर्वतः। परियान्ति महाराज गिरिराजं प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: O pure one, O great king, all the luminaries too turn round this prince of mountains in the self-same way.

sa: ततस्ते सागराः सर्वे समुपेत्य परस्परम्। नाध्यगच्छन्त तुरगमश्वहर्तारमेव च॥
en: Thereupon the sons of Sagara mutually united together could not find the horse nor the person who had stolen it.

sa: अनुग्रहो मे सुमहांस्तृप्तिश्च तव दर्शनात्। एकं तु कृतमिच्छामि त्वयाद्य प्रियमात्मनः॥
en: It is a great favour shown to me. I have been greatly pleased with you. Now I desire that you will today fulfill my wish.

sa: कर्तव्यमेव कर्मेति मनोरेष विनिश्चयः। एकान्तेन ह्यनीहोऽयं पराभवति पूरुषः॥
en: Man should always act; for this is the conclusion of Manu; a person that does not act is always defeated.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच पतिव्रतायाः सत्यायाः शीलाढ्याया यतव्रता संस्मृत्य वाक्यं धर्मज्ञ गुणवानसि मे मतः॥
en: The Brahmana said: O virtuous and vow-observing man, thinking of what that truthful, well-behaved and chaste lady told me, I am of opinion, that you really possess very high qualities.

sa: ते तं दृष्ट्वा हयं राजन् सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहाः। अनादृत्य महात्मानं कपिलं कालचोदिताः॥
en: Having seen him and the horse, they were flushed with delight. Being impelled by Fate, they did not care the presence of the illustrious Kapila.

sa: ओजसा तेजसा वीर यथा नान्यः पुमान् क्वचित् तथा हसन्निवाभीक्ष्णं ब्राह्मणोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्। न चैनं चालयामासधैर्यात् सुधृतनिश्चयम्॥
en: O hero, there is no man who is equal to you in energy and prowess." The Brahmana smilingly thus spoke to Arjuna. But he could not move him, who was so firm in his purpose.

sa: असमञ्जोभयाद् घोरात् ततो नस्त्रातुमर्हसि। पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा घोरं नृपतिसत्तमः॥ मुहूर्तं विमना भूत्वा सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्। असमञ्जाः पुरादद्य सुतो मे विप्रवास्यताम्॥
en: You should therefore protect us from the fearful danger proceeding from your son.” Having heard those terrible words of the citizens, that foremost of kings. Becoming absent-minded for a moment, spoke thus to his ministers, “Drive away at once my son Asaınanjasa from the city.

sa: राज्येऽभिषिच्य लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम्। धार्मिकं भक्तिमन्तं च भक्तानुगतवत्सलम्॥
en: Rama installed on the throne of Lanka, the Rakshasa chief Vibhishana who was virtuous, reverent and kind to devoted followers.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा तेजसो राशिं पुराणमृषिसत्तमम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ कार्यमस्मै न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Seeing that ancient great Rishi, a mass of effulgence, he bowed down his head to the ground and told him the reason of his coming.

sa: व्याध उवाच प्रत्यक्षं मम यो धर्मस्तं च पश्य द्विजोत्तम। येन सिद्धिरियं प्राप्ता मया ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव॥
en: The Fowler said: O foremost of Brahmanas, chief of the twice-born, behold with your own eyes all the virtues that I possess and by reason of which I have attained to this success (blissful state).

sa: शकुनिरुवाच धनंजयो वासुदेवो भीमसेनो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च दुपदश्च सहात्मजैः॥ नैते युधि पराजेतुं शक्या देवगणैरपि। महारथा महेष्वासाः कृतास्त्रा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥
en: Shakuni Said Dhananjaya, Vasudeva, Bhimasena, Yudhishthira, Nakula, Sahadeva, Drupada, and his two sons, these (heroes) cannot be conquered in a battle even by the celestials. They are all great car-warriors, and the wielders of great bows; they are accomplished in arms and invincible in war.

sa: तेषामपि गुणाः सर्वे गुणवृत्तिः परस्परम्। पूर्वपूर्वगुणाः सर्वे क्रमशो गुणिषु त्रिषु॥
en: These latter also have their (own peculiar) properties correlated to each other. Of the three qualities they are characterised by each in order of priority.

sa: अग्निधारां समासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताम्॥ तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणो ह्यग्निष्टोममवाप्नुयात्।
en: Going then to Agnidhara, celebrated all over the three worlds and bathing there, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: संस्कृतस्य च दान्तस्य नियतस्य यतात्मनः। प्राज्ञस्यानन्तरा वृत्तिरिह लोके परत्र च॥
en: Those who are freed from sin, those who are wise, forbearing, righteous and self-controlled enjoy continuous bliss in this world and in the world next.

sa: ततः कर्म समादत्ते पुनरन्यं नवं बहु। पच्यते तु पुनस्तेन भुक्त्वापथ्यमिवातुरः॥
en: Then they again accumulate a new store of actions and consequently they suffer misery over again, as does a discased man who eats unwholesome food.

sa: ते दर्शनं त्वनिच्छन्तो देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः। दुर्ग चक्रुरिमं देशं गिरि प्रत्यूहरूपकम्॥
en: The celestials with Sakra (Indra) at their head did not like to be seen and therefore they made this place inaccessible by raising up hills.

sa: यश्चैवं वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रूयात् प्रतिवचो नरः। तदादाय वचस्तस्य ममावेद्यं द्विजोत्तमाः॥
en: O excellent of the regenerate ones! do you convey to me the words of that man who, hearing these words of yours, will answer you.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणान् यदि वः प्रतिब्रूयात् कथंचन। स नरः सर्वथा ज्ञेयः कश्चासौ क्व नु वर्तते॥
en: If anybody answer you, as you would speak in this way, that man should be known by you in every way; and also it should be learnt what is he and where does he live.

sa: ततः संस्तीर्य रत्नस्तां तक्ष्ण आनाय्य सर्वशः। सुकृतां सुप्रवेशां च निवेदयत मे शनैः॥
en: Having brought carpenters and joiners, set jewels and precious stones all over its walls. Make it handsome and easy of access; and then inform me when every thing is complete.

sa: वध्यमाने शरीरे तु देहनाशो भवत्युत। जीवः सङ्क्रमतेऽन्यत्र कर्मबन्धनिबन्धनः॥
en: Thereupon when death occurs, only the body is destroyed, but the spirit bound in the bonds of actions goes elsewhere.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं पश्यसि ह्येतान् दिव्ययोगसमन्वितान्। शापानुग्रहणे शक्तान् देवेभ्योऽपि गरीयसः॥
en: You yourself see all these endued with celestials asceticism capable of cursing or blessing and superior even to the celestials,

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच यन्मया पाण्डवेयानां दृष्टं तच्छृणु भारत। आहृतं भूमिपालैहि वसु मुख्यं ततस्ततः॥
en: Duryodhana said O descendant of Bharata hear about all the best of wealth that belongs to the Pandavas and that was brought by the kings of earth one after another.

sa: संतापयति नः सर्वानसौ साधु निवार्यताम्। तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥ उमापतिर्भूतपतिर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।
en: He causes us pain. O exalted one, you ought to stop him." Having heard these words of those self-controlled Rishis. The husband of Uma, the lord of creatures, thus spoke.

sa: शकास्तुषाराः कङ्काश्च रोमशाः शृङ्गिणो नराः। महागजान् दूरगमान् गणितानर्बुदान् हयान्॥ शतशश्चैव बहुशः सुवर्णं पद्मसम्मितम्। बलिमादाय विविधं द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः॥
en: The Shakas, the Tusharas, the Kankas, the Romakas and the men with horns, bringing with them (as tribute) many large elephants which could go long distance, and also ten thousand horses and also hundreds of millions of gold, waited at the gate being refused admittance.

sa: एतन्मे भगवन् सर्वं विस्तरेण यथातथम्। वक्तुमर्हसि शुश्रूषोर्ऋष्यशृङ्गस्य चेष्टितम्॥
en: O exalted one, you should narrate to me all this in detail, the incidents of Rishyashringa's life as they happened.

sa: हयैर्विनीतैः सम्पन्नान् वैयाघ्रपरिवारितान्। विचित्रांश्च परिस्तोमान् रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: Well-trained horses covered with the tiger skins, rich and variegated blankets for covering elephants, various kinds of gems and jewels,

sa: तत्र त्वेको मुनिवरस्तं राजानमुवाच ह। कुपितास्तव राजेन्द्र ब्राह्मणा निष्कृतिं चर॥
en: son Thereupon one great Rishi thus spoke to the king, “O king of kings, the Brahmanas are angry with you. Do something to appease them.

sa: कर्मणस्तस्य घोरस्य बहुधा निर्णयो भवेत्। दाने च सत्यवाक्ये च गुरुशुश्रूषणे तथा॥ द्विजातिपूजने चाहं धर्मे च निरतः सदा। अभिमानातिवादाभ्यां निवृत्तोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तम॥
en: There are various ways in which evil Karma might be expiated, such as, by making gifts, by speaking truth and by serving the preceptor, by worshipping the order of the twice-born, by becoming devoted to virtue, free from pride and idle talk. O foremost of Brahmanas, I do these things.

sa: अज्ञायमानापि सती सुखमसम्युषिता त्वयि। सर्वकामैः सुविहिता रक्ष्यमाणा सदा त्वया॥ तु
en: “Although I stayed here unrecognised, still I lived with your happily and supplied with all the objects of my desire and ever protected by you.

sa: विधिस्तु बलवान् ब्रह्मन् दुस्तरं हि पुरा कृतम्। पुरा कृतस्य पापस्य कर्मदोषो भवत्ययम्॥
en: O Brahmana, Destiny in all powerful; it is difficuit to overcome the consequences of our past actions. This is the Karma, evil arising from sins committed in a former life.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच स तु विप्रमथोवाच धर्मव्याधो युधिष्ठिर। यदहमाचरे कर्म घोरमेतदसंशयम्॥
en: Markandeya said : O Yudhishthira, that virtuous fowler then said to that Brahmana, “The acts that I perform are certainly cruel, there is no doubt.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच परीक्षार्थं मयैतत् ते वाक्यमुक्तंधनंजय। ममात्मजस्य वचनं सूपपन्नमिदं तव॥
en: Indra said : "O Dhananjaya, in order to test you I have said these words. You being my son, this speech is worthy of you.

sa: क्व च त्वयाद्य गन्तव्यं प्रब्रूहि पुरुषर्षभ। अतः परमगम्योऽयं पर्वत: सुदुरारुहः॥
en: O foremost of men, tell me also where you intend to go today. It is impossible to go any further; the yonder mountain is inaccessible.

sa: भयं परिहरन् मन्द आत्मानं परिपालयन्। वर्षासु क्लिन्नकटवत् तिष्ठन्नेवावसीदति॥
en: The fool who cherishes himself by shunning all causes of fear destroys himself like an insect in the rainy season.

sa: समतीत्य बहून् देशान् गिरीश्च बहुपादपान्। सरांसि सरितश्चैव मार्तिकावतमासदम्॥
en: Passing over many countries, mountains and trees, many lakes and rivers, I at last arrived at the country of Martikavata.

sa: समागम्य भ्रातृभिः पार्थ तस्यां सुहृद्यूतं क्रियतां रम्यतां च। प्रीयामहे भवतां संगमेन समागताः कुरवश्चापि सर्वे॥
en: O son of Pritha, coming there enjoy the palace and play a friendly match at dice with your cousins. We shall be very happy at your arrival, so will be all the Kurus assembled there."

sa: सर्वा ल्लोकान् प्रपश्यामि प्रसादात् तव सुव्रत। वैखानसानां जपतामेष शब्दो महात्मनाम्॥
en: O vow-observing Rishi, through your grace I see all the regions. This is the sound of the recitations (of the Vedas) by the high-souled Rishis.

sa: सैषा प्रकाशते राजन् वेदी संस्थानलक्षणा। आरुह्यात्र महाराज वीर्यवान् वै भविष्यसि॥
en: O king, yonder before us is the spot with the distinct form of that sacred altar. O great king, ascending it, become great in prowess.

sa: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ श्रुत्वा सर्वमशेषतः। विनाशे शाल्वराजस्य तदैवाकरवं मतिम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, thereupon having heard all, I instantly made up my mind to kill king Shalva.

sa: भासि विद्युदिवाभ्रेषु शंस मे कासि कस्य वा। न हि ते मानुषं रूपं भूषणैरपि वर्जितम्॥
en: Do you blaze like lightning in the midst of clouds? O! tell me who are you and to whom do you belong? Surely your beauty is not human, although you are not decked in ornaments.

sa: तानब्रुवं यथाभूतमिदं कर्तास्मि संयुगे। निवातकवचानां तु प्रस्थितं मां वधैषिणम्॥ निबोधत महाभागाः शिवं चाशास्त ततो वाग्भिः प्रशस्ताभिस्त्रिदशाः पृथिवीपते। तुष्टुवुर्मी प्रसन्नास्ते यथा देवं पुरंदरम्॥
en: I related to them exactly what had passed and said "I will do this in battle, O sinless ones, O highly fortunate beings; know I have set out with the desire of slaying the Nivalakavachas and bless me for my success.” (And) being pleased, they paid their adoration to me as to the god, Purandara.

sa: लोमशस्तस्य तान् सर्वानाचख्यौ तत्र तापसान्। भृगूनाङ्गिरसश्चैव वसिष्ठानथ काश्यपान्॥
en: Lomasha told him there the names of all the ascetics, namely the Bhrigus, the Angiras, the Vasishthas and the Kashyapas.

sa: स शडी कवची बाणी प्रगृहीतशरासनः। दानवालयमत्युग्रं प्रयातोऽस्मि युयुत्सया॥
en: Desirous of fighting, I then set out for the terrible abode of the Danavas equipped with conch, armour and bow."

sa: अशोचत् तत्र वैदर्भी किं नु मे दुष्कृतं कृतम्। योऽपि मे निर्जनेऽरण्ये सम्प्राप्तोऽयं जनार्णवः॥ स हतो हस्तियूथेन मन्दभाग्यान्ममैव तत्। प्राप्तव्यं सुचिरं दुःखं नूनमद्यापि वै मया॥
en: The daughter of the king of the Vidharbhas again lamented, saying, 'What a misdeed I had committed in the past! As the result of my misfortune, the crowd of men, whose company I have found in this solitary wood, was all destroyed by elephants. As it seems, surely I shall have to suffer certain distresses for a pretty long period.

sa: ततस्ते पुरुषव्याघ्रा गत्वा स्त्रीभिस्तु संविदम्। कृत्वा व्यायामपूर्वाणि कृत्यानि प्रतिकर्म च॥
en: Having conversed with the ladies, those best of men (then) went through their daily physical exercises, and they then performed the usual daily religious rites.

sa: न मे स्यादपराधोऽयं महादेवातिसाहसात्। कृतो मयायमज्ञानाद् विमर्दो यस्त्वया सह। शरणं प्रतिपन्नाय तत् क्षमस्वाद्य शंकर॥
en: Let not my rashness in the combat that I have fought with you from ignorance be considered by you as a fault. O Shankara, I ask your protection. Pardon me for all I have done.

sa: तं विवाहे कृते राजन् सभार्यमवलोककः। आजगाम भृगुः श्रेष्ठं पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा ननन्द ह॥
en: O king, when the marriage ceremony was over, Bhrigu came to see his excellent son, who with his wife duly worshipped him; and seeing them he (Bhrigu) was greatly pleased.

sa: ततः श्रान्तं तु तद् रक्षो भीमसेनभुजाहतम्। सुपरिश्रान्तमालक्ष्य भीमसेनोऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Thereupon, struck by the fist of Bhima the Rakshasa fainted away and Bhima seeing this, too, holding that exhausted one.

sa: सर्वे विद्यासु निष्णाता बलवन्तो दुरासदाः। कुवलाश्वश्च पितृतो गुणैरभ्यधिकोऽभवत्॥
en: All these sons were powerful and fierce, but they were learned. Kuvalashva became superior to his father in all qualifications.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वाब्रवीदेनं नाभिजानामि भवन्तमिति स एवमुक्त इन्द्रद्युम्नः पुनस्तमुलूकमब्रवीद् राजर्षिः॥
en: It reflected for some time and then said, "No, I do not know you". Having been thus addressed, the royal sage Indradhyumna asked the owl,

sa: मण्डलानि विचित्राणि यमकानीतराणि च। सव्यानि च विचित्राणि दक्षिणानि च सर्वशः॥ प्रतोदेनाहता राजन् रश्मिभिश्च समुद्यताः। उत्पतन्त इवाकाशे व्यचरंस्ते हयोत्तमाः॥
en: O king, struck with the whip and pulled by the reins, those excellent horses, appeared as if they were flying in the air by performing various beautiful motions, now circular, now similar, now dissimilar, now going to the right and now going to the left.

sa: तत्राभिषिक्तः पृथुलोहिताश्च सहानुजैर्देवगणान् पितॄश्चा संतर्पयामास तथैव कृष्णा ते चापि विप्राः सह लोमशेन।॥
en: The large and red-eyed hero, having bathed in it with his brothers, offered oblations to the celestials and the Pitris. So did Krishna (Draupadi) and all the Brahmanas with Lomasha.

sa: हस्ताद्धि रश्मयश्चास्य प्रतोदः प्रापतद् भुवि। असकृच्चाह मां भीत: क्वासीति भरतर्षभा॥
en: And the golden whip fell on the ground from his hand. O best of the Bharata, getting terrified, he repeatedly cried out "Where are you?"

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः परं चक्रे विस्मयं परवीरहा। मया साक्षान्महादेवो दृष्ट इत्येव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, thereupon Arjuna, the slayer of hostile heroes, wondered much at it, saying, "O I have seen the great god of gods.

sa: अथवा त्वं वनपते नलं यदि न शंससि। मां खादय मृगश्रेष्ठ दुःखादस्माद् विमोचय॥
en: O lord of this forest! on the other hand, if you know nothing of Nala, then, O foremost of animals, devour me up and thereby relieve me from this misery.'

sa: वने चास्मिन् महाघोरे सिंहव्याघ्रनिषेविते। शयानमुपविष्टं वा स्थितं वा निषधाधिय॥ प्रस्थितं वा नरश्रेष्ठ मम शोकविवर्धन। कं नु पृच्छामि दुःखार्ता त्वदर्थे शोककर्शिता॥
en: O ruler of the Nishadhas! O foremost of men! ( you who are adding to my grief in this fearful wilderness infested by lions and tigers, of whom shall I, woeful and distressed with grief on your account, enquire whether you are sitting or lying down or staying or gone?

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच वृत्ते देवासुरे राजन् संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामिन्द्रो लोकाधिपोऽभवत्॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, when the fearful war between the Devas and the Asuras was over, Indra became the lord of all the worlds.

sa: राजोवाच इक्ष्वाकवो हन्त चरामि वः प्रियं निहन्मीमं विप्रमद्य प्रमथ्य। आनीयतामपरस्तिग्मतेजाः पश्यध्वं मे वीर्यमद्य क्षितीशाः॥
en: The king said: O Ikshvakus, I shall today of your good. I will with great force kill this Brahmana. Bring me another of my greatly effulgent arrows. O rulers of earth, behold my prowess today.

sa: कथमेका सती भैमी मया विरहिता शुभा। चरिष्यति वने घोरे मृगव्यालनिषेविते॥
en: How will this blessed daughter of Bhima, the chaste Damayanti, roam, without me and all alone, in this dreary wilderness, inhabited by beasts and serpents.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच एहि क्षत्तौपदीमानयस्व प्रियां भार्यां सम्मतां पाण्डवानाम्। सम्मार्जतां वेश्म परैतु शीघ्रं तत्रास्तु दासीभिरपुण्यशीला॥
en: Duryodhana said Come Khattwa, bring here Draupadi, the dear and the beloved wife of the Pandavas. Let her be forced to sweep the chambers, and let the unfortunate women remain where our serving women are.

sa: ततोऽस्मै प्राहरद् वज्रं घोररूपं शचीपतिः। तस्य प्रहरतो बाहुं स्तम्भयामास भार्गवः॥
en: The husband of Sachi (Indra), then hurled at him the fearful thunder. When he was about to hurl it, the son of Bhrigu paralyzed it.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच इहैवागत्य पाञ्चाली प्रश्नमेनं प्रभाषताम्। इहैव सर्वे शृण्वन्तु तस्याश्चैतस्य यद् वचः॥
en: Duryodhana said Let the princess of Panchala come here and put her question. Let every one here in this Sabha hear the worlds that pass between them (her and Yudhisthira).

sa: ततस्ते मन्त्रिणः सर्वे विज्ञाय नलशासनम्। अपि नो भागधेयं स्यादित्युक्त्वा नलमाव्रजन्॥
en: Thereupon all the ministers, having been informed of the summons of the king, uttered"O this was most unfortunate for them all” and advanced to Nala,

sa: आशङ्कय मद्वचो ह्येतद्धर्मलोपो भवेत् तवा जातोऽसि प्रथिते वंशे कुरूणां भरतर्षभ॥
en: If doubt comes to your mind, your virtue will be destroyed. O best of the Bharata race, you are born in the celebrated Kuru dynasty.

sa: मीशाः सुतानां च तथा स्नुषाणाम्। समीक्ष्य सर्वे मम चापि वाक्यं विब्रूत मे प्रश्नमिमं यथावत्॥
en: Here in this assembly are present the Kurus who are the lords of their sons and daughter-in-law. Let all of them, after duly reflecting on my words, properly answer me the question I have asked.

sa: विचित्राभरणाश्चैव नन्दयन्तीव मे मनः। अहं तु शरवर्षैस्तानस्त्रप्रचुदितै रणे।॥
en: And decked with various ornaments (they) attracted my mind. I, in that encounter, by showers of arrows shot from weapons,

sa: स एष कृष्णो वार्ष्णेयः पुराणपुरुषो विभुः। आस्ते हरिरचिन्त्यात्मा क्रीडन्निव महाभुजः॥
en: That deity is Krishna, the descendant of Vrishni, the ancient supreme lord, the inconceivable Hari, the mighty-armed hero, who seems to sport (in the world).

sa: देवानां मानुषं मध्ये यत् सा पतिमविन्दत। ततस्तस्या भवेन्न्याय्यं विपुलं दण्डधारणम्॥
en: "In as much as neglecting the divinities she has accepted a man for her husband, it is but severe cquitable that she shall suffer punishment?”

sa: भीष्मश्च धृतराष्ट्रश्च कुरुवृद्धतमावुभौ। समेत्य नाहतुः किंचिद् विदुरश्च महामतिः॥
en: Bhisma and Dhritarashtra, the two eldest of the Kurus, and the high-souled Vidura, uniting together, do not say any thing.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धर्मज्ञों बलवाञ्शूरः सत्यो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। भक्तोऽस्मानौरसः पुत्रो भीम गृहणातु मा चिरम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Bhima, let this powerful and heroic Rakshasha chief, your own begotten son, ever devoted to us and always truthful, carry (his) mother (Draupadi) without any delay.

sa: यदिदं द्रौपदीवाक्यमुक्तवत्यसकृच्छुभा। विमृश्य कस्य कः पक्षः पार्थिवा वदतोत्तरम्॥
en: O kings, answer the question asked by Draupadi and say after due reflection on which side each of you is.

sa: साधारणी च सर्वेषां पाण्डवानामनिन्दिता। जितेन पूर्वं चानेन पाण्डवेन कृतः पणः॥
en: The faultness Draupadi is the common wife of all the sons of Pandu. Having first lost himself, the Pandava (Yudhisthira) offered her as a stake.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ददर्श स पुरी रम्यां सिद्धचारणसेविताम्। सर्वर्तुकुसुमैः पुण्यैः पादपैरुपशोभिताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : He saw the beautiful city resorted to by Siddhas and Charanas, filled with flowers of all seasons and adorned with sacred trees.

sa: पीड्यमानाः समुत्थाय पाण्डवं पर्यवारयन्। वेपमानाः प्राञ्जलयस्ते सर्वे विकृताननाः॥
en: Being (sore) oppressed, rose up and with distorted countenances and joined hands and trembling (with fear), surrounded the Pandava (Arjuna).

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा तौ वीरौ स्पर्धमानौ परस्परम्। बाहुभ्यां समसज्जेतामुभौ रक्षोवृकोदरौ॥
en: Having said this, those two heroes, the Rakshasa and Vrikodara, challenged each other and caught each other by the arms.

sa: न स्म प्रज्ञायते किंचिदावृते व्योम्नि रेणुना। न चापि शेकुस्तत् कर्तुमन्योन्यस्याभिभाषणम्॥
en: The sky being covered with dust, nothing could be seen. They (the Pandavas) could not even express their mental feelings to one another by word.

sa: तमब्रवीद् गुरुः सोऽथ पच्यमानोऽग्निना भृशम्। त्वं मया याजितो राजंस्तस्येदं कर्मणः फलम्॥ एतच्छ्रुत्वा स राजर्षिर्धर्मराजमथाब्रवीत्। अहमत्र प्रवेक्ष्यामि मुच्यतां मम याजकः॥ मत्कृते हि महाभागः पच्यते नरकाग्निना।
en: Thereupon the preceptor, greatly being grilled in the (hell fire) thus spoke to him, “O king, it is the result of my performing your sacrifice.” Having heard this, that royal sage thus spoke to the god of justice? “I shall enter (this fire). Set free my priest. This greatly exalted man is grilled in the hell fire on my account.

sa: शशाप तत्र भीमस्तु राजमध्ये बृहत्स्वनः। क्रोधाद् विस्फुरमाणौष्ठो विनिष्पिष्य करे करम्॥
en: Thereupon Bhima, squeezing his palms, and his lips quivering in anger, took a terrible oath in a loud voice in the midst of the kings.

sa: कश्यप उवाच जाननविब्रुवन् प्रश्नान् कामात् क्रोधाद् भयात् तथा। सहस्रं वारुणान् पाशानात्मनि प्रतिमुञ्चति॥
en: Kashyapa said He, who knows but answers not a question from temptation, anger or fear, brings upon himself one thousand Pashas a sort of weapons) of Varuna upon his person.

sa: एकरात्रमुषित्वेह द्वितीयं यदि वत्स्यसि। एतद् वै ते दिवावृत्तं रात्रौ वृत्तमतोऽन्यथा॥
en: Having spent here the first night, if you pass the second night here, the events of the nighttime will then be different from the day-time.

sa: अद्य चात्र निवत्स्यामः क्षपां भरतसत्तम। द्वारमेतत् तु कौन्तेय कुरुक्षेत्रस्य भारत॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, O son of Kunti, we shall today live here. This is the gate of Kurukshetra.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच पुरस्तात् करणीयं मे न कृतं कार्यमुत्तरम्। विह्वलास्मि कृतानेन कर्षता बलिना बलात्॥
en: Draupadi said I have a duty to perform. I have not as yet performed that great work. Forcibly dragged by this strong man (Dushasana), I am deprived of my senses.

sa: कथं हि भार्या पाण्डूनां पार्षतस्य स्वसा सती। वासुदेवस्य च सखी पार्थिवानां सभामियाम्॥
en: How is it that the chaste wife of the Pandavas, the sister of the son of Prishata, the friend of Vasudeva (Krishna), is brought before the assembly of the kings?

sa: एषधर्मो यदि स्वार्थो ममापि भविता ततः। एवं स्वार्थं करिष्यामि तथा भद्रे विधीयताम्॥
en: If virtue be consistent with the seeking of one's own interest, I will surely look to it and so also do you, O gentle one, act according to this (principle).

sa: एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण नलः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। एकार्थं समुपेतं मां न प्रेषयितुमर्हथ॥
en: Nala, being thus spoken to by Shakra, requested them with folded hands not to send him, as he also has come with the same purpose.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य गेहे गोमायुरुच्चाहरदग्निहोत्रे। तं रासभाः प्रत्यभाषन्त राजन् समन्ततः पक्षिणश्चैव रौद्राः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon a jackal cried in the Homa chamber of king Dhritarashtra. O king asses began to bray responsively (with the jackal), and fearful birds from all quarters joined with them in their cries.

sa: सुखोषितास्तस्य त एकरात्रं पुण्याश्रमे देवमहर्षिजुष्टे। अभ्याययुस्ते बदरौं विशाला सुखेन वीराः पुनरेव वासम्॥
en: And having happily spent a night in that sacred hermitage frequented by the celestials and the Maharshis, those warriors gladly repaired to the great Jujube tree for a sojourn again.

sa: क्षीणे कलियुगे चैव प्रवर्तेत कृतं युगम्। एषा द्वादशसाही युगाख्या परिकीर्तिता॥
en: After Kali Yuga is over, Treta Yuga comes again; and thus it is said that all the Yugas comprise a cycle of twelve thousand years.

sa: नलोऽपि राजा कौन्तेय श्रुत्वा राज्ञां समागमम्। अभ्यगच्छददीनात्मा दमयन्तीमनुव्रतः॥
en: O son of Kunti, the lofty-minded king, Nala, hearing of the assembly of the kings, set out, thinking of Damayanti.

sa: ममागमनमाकाङ्क्षन् गङ्गाद्वारे समाहितः। वसेह द्रौपदी रक्षन् यावदागमनं मम॥
en: In expectation of my return, wait carefully at the source of the Ganges and protect Draupadi till I come back.

sa: मा दुहः पाण्डवान् राजन् कुरुष्व प्रियमात्मनः। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च लोकस्य च नरर्षभ॥
en: O king, do not quarrel with the Pandavas. O best of men, thus accomplish the good of your own, of the Pandavas, of the Kurus and of all the world.

sa: विचक्षणत्वं च भविष्यते नौ शिवश्च सौम्यश्च हि ब्रह्मघोषः॥
en: We shall also gain experience. The recitation of the Vedas is charming to hear and it is fraught with blessings."

sa: सुखेनागमनं कच्चिद् भगवन् कुरुजाङ्गलान्। कच्चित् कुशलिनो वीरा भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: O illustrious one, has your journey from the Kurujangal been a pleasant one? Are the heroes, the five Pandava brothers, living happily (there)?

sa: ते रथान् मेघसंकाशानास्थास सह कृष्णया। प्रययुर्हष्टमनस इन्द्रप्रस्थं पुरोत्तमम्॥
en: Accompanied with Krishna, and ascending their cars of colour of clouds, (Draupadi), they started for that best of cities, Indraprastha.

sa: कैलासः पर्वतो राजन् षड्योजनसमुच्छ्रितः। यत्र देवा समायान्ति विशाला यत्र भारत॥
en: O king, the Kailasa mountain is six yojanas in height. O descendant of Bharata, there is a large Jujube tree. Here often are the celestials,

sa: अक्षयूते च भगवन्धनं राज्यं च मे हृतम्। आहूय निकृतिप्रज्ञैः कितवैरक्षकोविदैः॥
en: "O almighty one, summoned by those evilminded and mischievous but skillful gamblers at dice. I have been deprived of my wealth and kingdom (through gambling).

sa: स शिक्षितो नृत्यगुणाननेकान्। वादित्रगीतार्थगुणांश्च सर्वान्। न शर्म लेभे परवीरहन्ता भ्रातृन् स्मरन् मातरं चैव कुन्तीम्॥
en: Having learnt various kinds of dance and various sorts of vocal and instrumental music, that slayer of hostile heroes, (Arjuna) did not (still) obtain any peace of mind, remembering his brothers and (his mother) Kunti.

sa: अधिगम्य च सर्वान् नो वनवासमिमं ततः। प्रव्राजयिष्यति पुनर्निकृत्याधमपूरुषः॥
en: And having thus traced us, that stupid one will again deceitfully banish us (to live in exile) into the woods.

sa: अस्माभिर्निर्जिता यूयं वने द्वादश वत्सरान्। वसध्वं कृष्णया सार्धमजिनैः प्रतिवासिताः॥ त्रयोदशं च सजने अज्ञाताः परिवत्सरम्। ज्ञाताश्च पुनरन्यानि वने वर्षाणि द्वादश॥ त्रयोदशे च निर्वृत्ते पुनरेव यथोचितम्। स्वराज्यं प्रतिपत्तव्यमितरैरथवेतरैः॥
en: (On the other hand), if you be defeated by us, you shall with Krishna (Draupadi) live for twelve years in the forest and pass the whole of the thirteenth year unrecognised in an inhabited country. If recognised, an exile of another twelve years is to be the consequence. On the expiry of the thirteenth year, each is to have his kingdom surrendered to the other.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं वै मद्विधो राजा स्वधर्ममनुपालयन्। आहूतो विनिवर्तेत दीव्यामि शकुने त्वया॥
en: Yudhisthira said. O Shakuni, how can a king like me who always observe the duty of his order refuse when challenged to dice? Therefore, I shall (again) play with you.

sa: धनेन मत्ता ये ते स्म धार्तराष्ट्रान् प्रहासिषुः। ते निर्जिता हृतधना वनमेष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Those Pandavas, who being intoxicated with the pride of wealth, laughed at the son of Dhritarashtra, will now have to go to the forest defeated and deprived of their wealth.

sa: तस्याभिपततस्तूर्णं गदाहस्तस्य संयुगे। गदां सर्वायसी पार्थः शरैश्चिच्छेद सप्तधा॥
en: As he was rushing with his mace in his hand, Partha (Arjuna) cut off that iron mace into seven pieces.

sa: बन्धुवाच अहं पुत्रो वरुणस्योत राज्ञो न मे भयं विद्यते मज्जितस्य। मष्टावक्रश्चिरनष्टं कहोडम्॥
en: Bandi said: I am the son of the king Varuna. I have therefore no fear to be drowned. Even at this very moment Ashtavakra would see his longlost father Kahoda.

sa: त्वं वै धर्मं विजानीषे युद्धे जेता धनंजयः। हन्तारीणां भीमसेनो नकुलस्त्वर्थसंग्रही॥
en: You know every rule of Dharma. Dhananjaya (Arjuna) is ever victorious in battle. Bhimsena is the slayer of foes, Nakula is the gatherer of wealth.

sa: राष्ट्रस्यारक्ष्यमाणस्य कुतो भूतिः कुतः सुखम्। न च राजावमन्तव्यो राक्षसा जात्वनागसि॥
en: If kingdoms become unprotected, how can prosperity and happiness be produced? unless an offence is given, no Rakshasa should commit any oppression on a king.

sa: जघन्यरात्रे निद्रान्धः सावशेषे तमस्यपि। चरन्तं गहनेऽरण्ये मेने स पितरं मृगम्॥
en: The night was far advanced and dark and he was drowsy with sleep. When roaming in the forest, he took his father for a deer.

sa: श्रुतं हि मे महाराज यथा पार्थेन संयुगे। एकादशतनुः स्थाणुर्धनुषा परितोषितः॥
en: O great king, I have heard how Arjuna has gratified in battle by means of his bow the god of gods, Sthanu of eleven forms.

sa: यथा कुन्ती महाभागा यथेन्द्राणी शची मम। तथा त्वमपि कल्याणी नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥
en: As the illustrious Kunti is to me, as the wife of Indra, Sachi, is to me. O blessed lady, so are you to me. There is no doubt about it.

sa: यत् स्वयं कर्मणा किंचित् फलमाप्नोति पूरुषः। प्रत्यक्षमेतल्लोकेषु तत् पौरुषमिति श्रुतम्॥
en: The fruit, that a person reaps by acting himself and which is the direct outcome of his actions, is considered as a proof of manliness.

sa: अथ जाता महीपालाः केचिद्बहुमदान्विताः। दितेः पुत्रा दनोश्चैव तदा लोक इहाच्युताः॥
en: Amongst the sons of Diti and Danu, some, being thrown off from heaven, took birth as men and became proud and insolent monarchs on earth.

sa: रत्नानि चाप्युपादाय बहूनि शतशो नराः। प्रददुः काङ्खमाणेभ्यः पाण्डोस्तस्यौर्ध्वदेहिके॥
en: Many hundreds of men began to distribute gems among the crowd at the time of the funeral ceremony of Pandu.

sa: इमे तयोः शरीरे द्वे पुत्राश्चेमे तयोर्वराः। क्रियाभिरनुगृह्यन्तां सह मात्रा परंतपाः॥
en: These are their bodies (unburnt portions); here also are their sons, the chastisers of foes, with their mother; let them be received in due honour.

sa: ज्येष्ठं युधिष्ठिरेत्येवं भीमसेनेति मध्यमम्। अर्जुनेति तृतीयं च कुन्तीपुत्रानकल्पयन्॥
en: The eldest of the Kunti's sons was called Yudhisthira, the second was named Bhimasena and the third was named Arjuna.

sa: तितीर्षुर्लक्ष्मणो गङ्गां शुभां नावमुपारुहत्। गङ्गां संतारयामास लक्ष्मणस्तां समाहितः॥
en: Having them brought about to cross the holy Ganga Laksmana, with a quiescent mind, took her to the other side.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा तां नमस्कृत्य पुनर्नावमुपारुहत्॥ आरुरोह पुनर्नावं नाविकं चाभ्यचोदयत्।
en: Having addressed Sītā in this wise Lakşmaņa again sent for a boat and ascending it ordered the boatman to go.

sa: सहसोत्पतितां श्यामां दृष्ट्वा तां साश्रुलोचनाम्। तूर्णं सकाशं काव्यस्य प्रस्थितां व्यथितस्तदा॥
en: Having said this, she with tearful eyes quickly rose to go away to her father. And the king was grieved to see her thus angry.

sa: अनुवव्राज सम्भ्रान्तः पृष्ठतः सान्त्वयन् नृपः। न्यवर्तत न चैव स्म क्रोधसंरक्तलोचना॥
en: He became very much alarmed; and he followed her, trying to appease her wrath. But she did not return. Her eyes were red in anger.

sa: तान् पाद्यमधुपर्कार्हान् गवार्हान् सत्कृतिं गतान्। प्रत्युत्थाय जरासंध उपतस्थे यथाविधि॥ उवाच चैतान् राजासौ स्वागतं वोऽस्त्विति प्रभुः। मौनमासीत् तदा पार्थभीमयोर्जनमेजय॥
en: Jarasandha rose up in haste saying “Welcome to you”. He received his visitors with proper ceremonies, with water to wash their feet, with honey, with Arghya, with gift of kine and with the other forms of respect. O Janamejaya, both Partha and Bhima remained silent.

sa: ययातिरुवाच अतृप्तो यौवनस्याहं देवयान्यां भृगूद्वह। प्रसादं कुरु मे ब्रह्मञ्जरेयं न विशेच माम्॥
en: Yayati said : O son of Bhrigu, I have not been as yet satiated with youth of Devayani. Therefore, O Brahmana, be graceful to Let not decrepitude overcome me. me.

sa: ययातिरुवाच जरा वली च मां तात पलितानि च पर्यगुः। काव्यस्योशनसः शापान च तृप्तोऽस्मि यौवने॥
en: Yayati said : O child; Old age, wrinkles and white hair have come over to me by the curse the son of Kavi who is called Ushanas. But I am not yet satiated with youth.

sa: एवं स राजा तं शापमुपभुङ्क्ते सुदारुणम्। कार्यार्थिनां विमर्दो हि राज्ञां दोषाय कल्पते॥ तच्छीघ्रं दर्शनं मह्यमभिवर्तन्तु कार्यिणः। सुकृतस्य हि कार्यस्य फलं नावैति पार्थिवः। तस्माद्गच्छ प्रतीक्षस्व सौमित्रे कार्यवाञ्जनः॥
en: O Lakşmaņa, the king Nțga is still suffering from that dreadful curse. It is the king's folly that is manifest from the mutual disagreement of the workers. Do you bring them all speedily to me who have come for business. For, sooth shall the kings profit by the just administration. Do you therefore go in person, O Lakşmaņa and see who has come for business.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तो भगवता प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः। भीमार्जुनौ समालोक्य सम्प्रहृष्टमुखौ स्थितौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed by that exalted being (Krishna), and having seen Bhima and Arjuna standing there with cheerful face, Yudhishthira thus replied.

sa: एष ते नृगशापस्य विस्तरोऽभिहितो मया। यद्यस्ति श्रवणे श्रद्धा शृणुष्वेहापरां कथाम्॥
en: I Have thus given to you an account of the curse imprecated on Nțga. Listen, if do you wish to hear of any other theme.

sa: देवयान्युवाच आहुतं चाग्निहोत्रं ते सूर्यश्चास्तं गतः प्रभो। अगोपाचागता गावः कचस्तात न दृश्यते॥
en: Devayani said: O sire, the Agnihotra (evening fire) is kindled, the sun has also set. The kine have come back without their cowherd. But Kacha is not to be seen.

sa: निक्षिप्तदेहौ काकुत्स्थ कथं तौ द्विजपार्थिवौ। पुनर्देहेन संयोग जग्मतुर्देवसंमतौ॥
en: O Kakuthstha, how did that twice-born one worshipped by the celestials and the king regain their bodies, after being bodiless.

sa: ते तदानं द्विधा कृत्वा भक्षयामासतुः शुभे। भावित्वादपि चार्थस्य सत्यवाक्यतया मुनेः॥ गर्भः फलप्राशनसम्भवः। ते च दृष्ट्वा स नृपतिः परां मुदमवाप ह॥
en: His two beautiful wives ate the mango, dividing it into two equal parts. In consequence of the certainty of the Muni's words and his truthfulness both of them conceived as an effect of their having eaten that fruit. Seeing them in that state, the king was filled with great joy.

sa: महदद्भुतमाश्चर्य विदेहस्य पुरातनम्। निर्वृत्तं राजशार्दूल वसिष्ठस्य मुनेश्च ह॥
en: O foremost of kings, this ancient account of the ascetic Vasiştha and the king Nimi is highly surprising and wonderful.

sa: न स्म मृत्यु विद्म रात्रौ वा यदि वा दिवा। न चापि कंचिदमरमयुद्धेनानुशुश्रुम॥
en: We do not know when death will overtake us, whether in the night or in the day; nor have we heard the immortality has been obtained by desisting from battle.

sa: कृष्णे नयो मयि बलं जयः पार्थे धनञ्जये। मागधं साधयिष्याम इष्टिं त्रय इवाग्नयः॥
en: (We have) in Krishna policy, in me strength, and in Partha (Dhananjaya) victory. Like the three (sacrificial) fires, we shall bring about the death of the king of Magadha (Jarasandha)

sa: यदि त्वेनं महाराज यज्ञं प्राप्तुमभीप्ससि। यतस्व तेषां मोक्षाय जरासंधवधाय च॥
en: O great king, if you desire to perform the sacrifice, try to release those (the kings) kept prisoners by Jarasandha and try to kill him.

sa: अष्टादश सहस्राणि भ्रातृणां सन्ति नः कुले। आहुकस्य शतं पुत्रा एकैकस्त्रिदशावरः॥
en: There are eighteen thousand brothers and cousins in our race. Ahuka has been hundred sons, each of whom is like the best of the celestialss.

sa: हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य नियतं पुरुषर्षभ। आदाय गच्छ शत्रुघ्न पर्याप्तधनवाहनः॥
en: O foremost of men, O Śatrughna, do you proceed with Niyuta gold and silver coins and necessary riches and conveyances.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु तद्रक्षस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। कालपर्याययोगेन राजा मित्रसहोऽभवत्॥
en: Having said this the Rākşasa vanished therefrom. Thereupon in time the prince Mitrasaha became king.

sa: ययातिरपि पत्नीभ्यां दीर्घकालं विहृत्य च। विश्वाच्या सहितो रेमे पुनश्चैत्ररथे वने॥
en: He enjoyed for a long time the sweet company of his two wives. He enjoyed with (Apsara) Vishvachi in the gardens of Chitraratha (Gandharva king.)

sa: सिद्धा देवर्षयश्चैव साध्या देवगणास्तथा। मरुत्वन्तश्च सहिता भास्वन्तो हेममालिनः॥
en: The Siddhas, the celestials Rishi, the Sadhyas the celestialss, and celestialss, and the bright complexioned Marutas adorned with golden garlands;

sa: एवं स राजा सुमहान्हतः सबलवाहनः। शूलस्य तु बलं सौम्य अप्रमेयमनुत्तमम्॥
en: In this wise the high-souled king Māndhāta, with his huge army, was slain. O gentle hero, incomparable and great is the strength of the dart..

sa: ऋषयोऽप्यद्य पापात्मन्मया त्वां निहतं रणे। पश्यन्तु विप्रा विद्वांसस्त्रिदशा इव रावणम्॥
en: O you of a vicious soul, as did the celestials behold Rāvana slain so shall the Rșis and learned Brāhmaṇas behold you, destroyed by me.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य लवणो वृक्षमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। शिरस्यभ्यहनच्छूरं स्रस्ताङ्गः स मुमोह वै॥
en: Rather laughing aloud the valiant Räksasa uprooted a tree and struck him with that on the head. With that stroke he was wounded and slain.

sa: गां चैव मधुपर्कं च सम्प्रदायार्घ्यमेव च। अर्चयामास रत्नैश्च सर्वकामैश्च धर्मवित्॥
en: The virtuous (king) offered him kine, Arghya and Madhuparka (a preparation of honey). He worshipped him with gems and jewels and with his whole heart.

sa: ये चाश्रयं वेदयन्ते पुराणं मनीषिणो मानसमार्गरुद्धम्। तद्वः श्रेयस्तेन संयोगमेत्य परां शान्तिं प्राप्नुयुः प्रेत्य चेह॥
en: Those learned men who accept as their only support the unchangeable and inconceivable Brahma, Brahma that showers blessings on persons virtuous as you are, enjoy perfect peace here in this world and hereafter in heaven.

sa: तं जीवयथ भद्रं वो नानृतं कर्तुमर्हथ। द्विजस्य संश्रुतोऽर्थो मे जीवयिष्यामि ते सुतम्॥
en: Do you restore him to life. I have promised before that leading twice-born one that I would restore his son to life, do you therefore, make not me a liar.

sa: सोऽहं वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्त्रीणि महावने। तप्त्वा सुदुष्करं प्राप्तो ब्रह्मलोकमनुत्तमम्॥
en: Having performed hard penances in this forest, for three thousand years I at last attained to the region of Brahmā.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry "success".

sa: एवं दत्त्वा वरं ताभ्यां सह देवैर्मरुत्पतिः। हुताशनमनुज्ञाप्य जगाम त्रिदिवं प्रभुः॥
en: Having granted these boons to those (heroes) and having spoken to Agni, the lord of the Marutas, accompanied by the celestial, went away to heaven.

sa: ययातिरुवाच ययातिरस्मि नहुषस्य पुत्रः पूरोः पिता सार्वभौमस्त्विहासम्। गुह्यं चार्थं मामकेभ्यो ब्रवीमि मातामहोऽहं भवतां प्रकाशम्॥
en: Yayati said: I tell you truly, I am Yayati, the son of Nahusha and the father of Puru. I was a Sarvabhauma (Universal monarch) on earth. You are my kinsmen. I am your maternal grandfather.

sa: यदष्टक प्रब्रवीमीह सत्यं प्रतर्दनं चौषदश्विं तथैवा सर्वे च लोका मुनयश्च देवाः सत्येन पूज्या इति मे मनोगतम्॥
en: O Ashtaka, all that I have told you, Pratardana and Vasuman, the son of Uşadasva is the truth itself. I know that all the worlds, all the Rishis and all the celestials are adorable only because Truth characterises them all.

sa: स प्रचक्रे महाबाहुमूंगयां रुचिरे वने। चैत्रे मनोरमे मासे सभृत्यबलवाहनः॥ प्रजघ्ने स नृपोऽरण्ये मृगाञ्छतसहस्रशः। हत्वैव तृप्ति भूच्च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Once on a time in the picturesque season of spring the mighty-armed Ila, with his army and conveyances, entered into a charming forest, and on the pretext of hunting, slew hundreds and thousands of deer. With slaying deer only the high-souled king was not satisfied.

sa: राज्ञां तु राक्षसोऽप्युक्तो विट्शूद्रेष्वासुरः स्मृतः। पञ्चानां तु त्रयो धा अधौ द्वौ स्मृताविह॥
en: To the kings, even the Rakshasas form is permissible. The Asura form is permissible to the Vaishyas and Shudras. Of the first five (forms), three are proper and two improper.

sa: देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः। आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण॥
en: O Laksmana, do you also invite carefully, for witnessing the ceremony, other pious foreign kings who are friendly to me.

sa: न शशाक स निर्गन्तुं निरुद्धोऽर्जुनपत्रिभिः। मोक्षयामास तं माता निगीर्य भुजगात्मजा॥
en: Confined by Arjuna's arrows, he could not succeed to come out (of the forest), but the snakes lady, his mother, determined to save his life.

sa: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः स्त्रीभिश्च बहुभिर्वृतः। ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां पूजां चक्रे महात्मनाम्॥
en: And Vibhīşaņa, surrounded by various Räkşasas and females, engaged in the service of the high-souled Rsis intent on hard penances.

sa: इमानि च फलान्यत्र स्वादूनि विविधानि च। जातानि पर्वताग्रेषु आस्वाद्यास्वाद्य गायताम्॥
en: And eating all those sweet fruits that are on the summit of the mountain near our hermitage, do you engage in chanting the sweet Rāmāyaṇa.

sa: ऋषिः कश्चिदिहागम्य मम जन्माभ्यचोदयत्। तस्मै प्रोवाच भगवान् यथा तच्छणु पार्थिव॥
en: Once on a time, a Rishi came here and asked about my birth. () king, hear what the illustrious Rishi (Kanva) told him about me.

sa: श्रुतं कर्म महत् कृत्वा निवृत्तेन किरीटिना। जातः पुत्रस्तथेत्येवं श्रुतकर्मा ततोऽभवत्॥
en: Because Arjuna's son was born on his relurn from exile during which he had achieved many celebrated feats, that child came to be called Shrutakarma.

sa: केचिद्विनेदुः संहृष्टाः केचिद्ध्यानपरायणाः। केचिद्रामं निरीक्षन्ते केचित्सीतामचेतसः॥
en: Some cried aloud in joy, some remained silent, and some motionless espied Rāma or Sītā.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु रामेण समागच्छद् यथाविधि। मूर्षि केशवमाघ्राय बाहुभ्यां परिषस्वजे॥
en: Yudhishthira received Rama with all due ceremonies and the king embraced Keshava with both his arms ad smelt his head.

sa: ताभ्यां प्रतिगृहीतं तु वृष्णिचक्रं महर्द्धिमत्। विवेश खाण्डवप्रस्थं पताकाध्वजशोभितम्॥
en: Having been welcomed by them, the Vrishni heroes of great prosperity entered Khandavaprastha which was well-adorned with flags and standards.

sa: उचितश्चैव सम्बन्धः सुभद्रां च यशस्विनीम्। एष चापीदृशः पार्थः प्रसह्य हृतवानिति॥
en: This alliance is very proper. Subhadra is an illustrious girl and so is Partha. Thinking all this, he has taken her away by force. a

sa: अरिहः खल्वाङ्गेयीमुपयेमे सुदेवां नाम। तस्यां पुत्रमजीजनदृक्षम्॥
en: Ariha married Sudeva, the princess of Anga and she gave birth to a son, Riksha.

sa: यानि भूतानि नगरेऽप्यन्तर्धानगतानि च। राघवं तान्यनुययुः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितम्॥
en: And all other animals, that were beyond the view of all in the city went after Rāghava proceeding to heaven.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted the Supreme Deity (Narayana) and the highest of all male beings (Nara) and also the Goddess of Learning (Sarasvati), let us cry success!

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कौन्तेयः पन्नगेश्वरकन्यया। कृतवांस्तत् तथा सर्वं धर्ममुद्दिश्य कारणम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed by the daughter o the Naga king, the son of Kunti, making virtue his motive, did everything as she desired.

sa: स सदस्यैः सहासीनः श्रावयामास भारतम्॥ कर्मान्तरेषु यज्ञस्य चोद्यमानः पुनः पुनः।
en: Vaishampayana, sitting together with his comrades, recited the Bharata at the intervals of the sacrifice and he was repeatedly asked to proceed when he stopped.

sa: परस्पराश्लिष्टशाखैः पादपैः कुसुमान्वितैः। अशोभत वनं तत् तु महेन्द्रध्वजसंनिभैः॥
en: The trees, with its flowery branches, entwining with one another, looked exceedingly beautiful and appeared like so many Indra's poles.

sa: ततो राजन्नदृश्यद्भिर्ऋषिभिश्च महासुरौ। उभौ विनिश्चयं कृत्वा विकुर्वाते वधैषिणौ॥
en: O king, when all the Rishis had disappeared, the two great Asuras resolved upon their destruction and assumed various forms.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सम्भवं भरतस्याहं चरितं च महामतेः। शकुन्तलायाश्चोत्पत्तिं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Janamejaya said : I desire to hear in detail the account of the birth and career of the high-souled Bharata and the birth of Shakuntala.

sa: एवं सर्वान् समादिश्य पूर्वतीरे महोदधेः। क्रूरां मतिं समास्थाय जग्मतुः सर्वतोमुखौ॥
en: Thus ordering them all on the eastern shore of the great ocean and forming such a cruel resolution, the Asura brothers started in all directions.

sa: स भोगान्विविधाम्भुञ्जन् रत्नानि विविधानि च। कथितो धृतराष्ट्रस्य विवर्णो हरिणः कृशः॥
en: It was represented to Dhritarashtra that his son notwithstanding he was partaking various objects of enjoyments and valuable things, was becoming pale, lean and meagre.

sa: गदापट्टिशधारिण्या शूलमुद्गरहस्तया। प्रस्थितौ सह वर्मिण्या महत्या दैत्यसेनया॥ मङ्गलैः स्तुतिभिश्चापि विजयप्रतिसंहितैः। चारणैः स्तूयमानो तौ जग्मतुः परया मुदा॥
en: A large army of the Danavas clad in mails and armed with clubs, axes, lances and maces, went with them. The Charanas chanted auspicious panegyrics indicative of their future victory; and they sat out on their expedition with joyous hearts.

sa: निरस्य विदुरं भीष्मं द्रोणं शारद्वतं कृपम्। विग्रहे तुमुले तस्मिन्दहन्क्षत्रं परस्परम्॥
en: In spite of Bhishma, Drona, Vidura and the son of Shardvata, Kripa, he made the Kshatriyas kill one another in the great battle that followed.

sa: स विराटस्य दुहितरमुपयेमे उत्तरां नाम। तस्यामस्य परासुर्गर्भोऽभवत्। तमुत्सङ्गेन प्रतिजग्राह पृथा नियोगात् पुरुषोत्तमस्य वासुदेवस्य, पाण्मासिकं गर्भमहमेनं जीवयिष्यामीति॥
en: He married Uttara, the daughter of the king of Virata. She gave birth to a dead child, whom Pritha (Kunti) took up on her lap at the command of Krishna, who said, "I will revive this child of six months.”

sa: आशिषो विविधाः प्रोच्य राजपुत्र्यास्तु नारदः। गम्यतामिति होवाच भगवांस्तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: The illustrious Rishi Narada, after uttering various benedictions on the princess and saying that faultless lady, “Go," sent her away.

sa: यदाश्रौषं देवराजेन दत्तां दिव्यां शक्तिं व्यंसितां माधवेन। घटोत्कचे राक्षसे घोररूपे तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that through the machinations of Krishna, the celestial weapon Shakti, given to Karna by Indra, had been hurdled against Ghatotkacha of a dreadful form.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच संजयैवं प्राणांस्त्यक्तुमिच्छामि मा चिरम्। स्तोकं ह्यपि न पश्यामि फलं जीवितधारणे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: After what has happened, O Sanjaya, I desire to abandon this life without any further delay. I do not see any good by keeping it alive any longer.

sa: नाकुलिस्तु शतानीकः श्रुतसेनश्च वीर्यवान्। शूरो नाम यदुश्रेष्ठो वसुदेवपिताभवत्॥
en: Shatanika, the son of Nakula and the powerful Shrutasena. The best of the Yadus, Shura, became the father of Vasudeva.

sa: दिष्ट्या वर्धामहे सर्वे दिष्ट्या शान्तः पुरोचनः । दिष्ट्या मम परं दुःखमपनीतं महाद्युते॥
en: From our good fortune our strength is increased; and from our good fortune Purochana is dead. O greatly effulgent one, from our good fortune my great grief is also removed.

sa: देवादेवर्षयो ह्यत्र तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः। कीर्त्यन्ते शुभकर्माणस्तथा यक्षा महोरगाः॥
en: In this Bharata, sinless and immaculate Devas, Devarshis and Brahmanas have been described as well as Yakshas and great Nagas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच समावृतव्रतं तं तु विसृष्टं गुरुणा तदा। प्रस्थितं त्रिदशावासं देवयान्यब्रवीदिदम्॥ ऋषेरङ्गिरसः पुत्र वृत्तेनाभिजनेन च। भ्राजसे विद्यया चैव तपसा च दमेन च।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the period of his vow expired and when he was prepared to go to the land of the celestials, after having received the permission of his preceptor, Devayani addressed him thus-"O the grandson of Rishi Angirasa, you shine most brightly in conduct, in birth, in learning, in asceticism and in humility.

sa: धर्मस्यांशं तु राजानं विद्धि राजन्युधिष्ठिरम्। भीमसेनं तु वातस्य देवराजस्य चार्जुनम्॥
en: Know, O king, king Yudhishthira was a portion of Dharma; Bhima was that of Maruta; Arjuna was that of the king of the celestials (Indra).

sa: एतत् तव महाराज पुत्रेषु तेषु चैव हि। वृत्तयौपयिकं मन्ये भीष्मेण सह भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in my opinion and that of Bhishma, this should be your conduct towards the Pandavas, who stand to you in the relation of your own sons.

sa: कुन्तीमासाद्य ता नार्यो द्रुपदस्य महात्मनः। नाम संकीर्तयन्त्योऽस्या जग्मुः पादौ स्वमूर्धभिः॥
en: The ladies of the illustrious Draupada's (household) all came to Kunti; and mentioning their respective names, they saluted her with their heads touching the ground.

sa: षष्ठस्तु मतिमान्यो वै तेषामासीन्महासुरः। अभीरुरिति विख्यातः क्षितौ राजर्षिसत्तमः॥
en: That greatly intelligent and powerful Asura who was the sixth (brother) became the vest of royal sages Abhiru on earth.

sa: पर्वानुक्रमणी पूर्वं द्वितीय: पर्वसंग्रहः। पौष्यं पौलोममास्तीकमादिरंशावतारणम्॥
en: The first is called Anukramanika, the second Parva Sangraha; then come Pauloma, Paushya, Astika, Adianshavatarana,

sa: द्रौपदीहरणं पर्व जयद्रथविमोक्षणम्। पतिव्रताया माहात्म्यं सावित्र्याश्चैवमद्भुतम्॥
en: Then Draupadi-Harana-Parva, then Jayadratha-Vimochana, then the story of Savitri, illustrating love of husband and chastity;

sa: तोषयामास तपसा सा किलोग्रेण शंकरम्। तामुवाचेश्वरः प्रीतो वृणु काममिति स्वयम्॥
en: She gratified by her asceticism the deity Shankara (Shiva). The deity being pleased with her, himself thus spoke to her “Tell me what you want."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो व्यासः परमोदारकर्मा शुचिर्विप्रस्तपसा तस्य राज्ञः। चक्षुर्दिव्यै प्रददौ तांश्च सर्वान् राजाऽपश्यत् पूर्वदेहैर्यथावत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, that holy Brahmana, Vyasa of greatly generous deeds, gave celestial sight to that king (Drupada) by his ascetic power. Then the king saw them (the Pandavas) all possessing their former forms.

sa: संभवो जतुवेश्माख्यं हिडिम्बबकयोर्वधः। तथा चैत्ररथं देव्याः पाञ्चाल्याश्च स्वयंवर॥
en: Sambhava; the burning of the house of lac, the destruction of Hidimba and Baka and Chaitraratha, the Svayamvara of Draupadi;

sa: ततः स राजा दुपदः प्रहृष्टः पुरोहितं प्रेषयामास तेषाम्। विद्याम् युष्मानिति भाषमाणो महात्मानः पाण्डुसुतास्तु कच्चित्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the king Drupada became exceedingly pleased and he sent to then his priest, directing him to ascertain who they were and whether they were (really) the sons of the illustrious Pandu.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स राजा शान्तनु/मान् देवराजर्षिसत्कृतः। धर्मात्मा सर्वलोकेषु सत्यवागिति विश्रुतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The king Shantanu, adored of the celestials and the royal sages, was famous in all the worlds as being virtuous-minded and truthful.

sa: खाण्डवप्रस्थमध्यस्थो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। आसीत् परमया लक्ष्म्या सुहृद्गणवृतः प्रभुः॥
en: Surrounded by his friends and relatives, the lord Dharmaraja Yudhishthira lived in the enjoyment of great affluence with in Khandavaprastha.

sa: तस्य कीर्तिमतो वृत्तमवेक्ष्य सततं नराः। धर्म एव परः कामादर्थाचेति व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: The people, seeing the (virtuous) acts of that king of great achievements, came to know that virtue was ever superior to pleasure and profit. was

sa: सुपर्ण इति विख्यातस्तस्मादवरजस्तु यः। कालकीर्तिरिति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवनृपः॥
en: That Asura who was the younger brother of Mayura and who was known as Suparna, became king Kalakirti on earth.

sa: स हास्तिनपुरे रम्ये कुरूणां पुटभेदने। वसन् सागरपर्यन्तामन्वशासद् वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Shantanu lived in Hastinapur, the beautiful capital of the Kurus; he ruled over the whole earth bounded by the sea.

sa: यत्र रामेण विक्रम्य निहतो रावणो युधि। सावित्र्याश्चाप्युख्यानमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: In which is shown how Ravana was killed by the prowess of Rama. Then is narrated the story of Savitri,

sa: इत्युक्ते वचने कृष्णो यत्रोवाच महामतिः। अयुध्यमानमात्मानं मन्त्रिणं पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: When these words were uttered, the highsouled Krishna replied, “O best of men, a counsellor (myself) who will not fight,

sa: वरान्वेषणमत्रैव मातलेश्च महात्मनः। महर्षेःचापि चरितं कथितं गालवस्य वै॥
en: Then the search for a bridegroom by Matali for his daughter; then follows the history of the great Rishi Galava.

sa: विभूषिताङ्गाः पृथुवाहवस्ते। अनुक्रम विक्रमसत्त्वयुक्ता बलेन वीर्येण च नर्दमानाः॥
en: Adorned with crowns, garlands, bracelets and other ornaments, possessing mighty arms, prowess and vigour and full of strength and energy,

sa: इषुपान्नाम यस्तेषामसुराणां बलाधिकः। नग्नजिन्नाम राजासीद्भुवि विख्यातविक्रमः॥
en: That great strong Asura, who was known as Ishupada, became king Nagnajita of worldknown prowess.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सौप्तिकं पर्व दारुणम्। भग्नोरं यत्र राजानं दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥ अपयातेषु पार्थेषु त्रयस्तेऽभ्याययूरथाः। कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणि: सायाह्ने रुधिरक्षितम्॥
en: I shall now describe the contents of the terrible tenth Parva, named Sauptika. On the departure of the Pandavas the great car-warrior, Kritavarma. Kripa and the son of Drona (Ashvathama) came in the evening to he place where Duryodhana was lying with the brocken thigh.

sa: प्रियं तस्याचिकीर्षन्वै गदामादाय वीर्यवान्। अन्वधावत्सुसंक्रुद्धो भारद्वाजं गुरोः सुतम्॥
en: Determined to please her, he speedily took up his club and ran in pursuit of the son of his preceptor.

sa: ततः कदाचिच्छोचन्तं शान्तनुं ध्यानमास्थितम्। पुत्रो देवव्रतोऽभ्येत्य पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: One day when he was thus meditating over (the girl) in sorrow, his son Devavrata came to him and said-

sa: न चाप्यहं वृथा भूयो दारान् कर्तुमिहोत्सहे। संतानस्याविनाशाय कामये भद्रमस्तु ते॥
en: I do not, therefore, desire to marry again. I only desire that prosperity may always attend on you, SO that our dynasty may be perpetuated.

sa: अशिष्टानां नियन्ता हि शिष्टानां परिरक्षिता। स्थाने रोषः प्रयुक्तः स्यान्नृपैः सर्वजिगीषुभिः॥
en: The wrath, that the kings, desirous of subjugating the whole world, display, has its use. It serves to restrain the wicked and protect the honest.

sa: आख्यानं तदिदमनुत्तमं महार्थं विज्ञेयं महदिह पर्वसंग्रहेण। श्रुत्वादौ भवति नृणां सुखावगाहं विस्तीर्णं लवणजलं यथा प्लवेन॥
en: As the wide ocean can be easily crossed by men having boats, so this extensive history of great excellence and deep meaning can be understood by the help of this chapter, which is called Parva-Sangraha.

sa: पितर ऊचुः और्व दृष्टः प्रभावस्ते तपसोग्रस्य पुत्रका प्रसादं कुरु लोकानां नियच्छ क्रोधमात्मनः॥
en: The Pitris said : O Aurva, O son, fierce you have become by your asceticism. Your power has been seen by us. Be propitious to the worlds; control your anger.

sa: भृगुपन्यो गिरिं दुर्गं हिमवन्तं प्रपेदिरे। तासामन्यतमा गर्भ भयाद् दधे महौजसम्॥
en: One among them, a lady of tapering things, desiring to perpetuate her husband's race, kept a greatly energetic embryo hidden in one of her things.

sa: शक्तोऽहमपि शप्तुं त्वां मान्यास्तु ब्राह्मणा मम। जानतोऽपि च ते ब्रह्मन्कथयिष्ये निबोध तत्॥
en: I can also curse you, but Brahmanas are held in respect by me. Although, O Brahinana, these are known to you, I shall yet speak them to you. Please understand.

sa: ततः प्रविष्टे राजर्षों तस्मिंस्तत् पुरमुत्तमम्। राज्ञस्तस्याज्ञया देवी वसिष्ठमुपचक्रमे॥
en: After the royal sage (the king Kalmashapada) had entered that excellent city, the queen at his command, came to Vasishtha.

sa: राजोवाच नावमंस्ये महाभाग कदाचिद् ब्राह्मणानहम्। त्वनिदेशे स्थितः सम्यक् पूजयिष्याम्यहं द्विजान्॥
en: The King said: O illustrious sir, I shall never again disregard the best Brahmanas. In obedience to your command, I shall properly worship the Brahmanas.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः। वारयामास तेजस्वी हुकारेणैव भारत॥
en: The Gandharva said : O descendant of Bharata, the illustrious and the effulgent Rishi Vasishtha, seeing him advancing, stopped him by uttering a loud roar.

sa: स समुद्रमभिप्रेक्ष्य शोकविष्टो महामुनिः। बद्धवा कण्द्दे शिलां गुरु निपपात तदाम्भसि॥
en: Then seeing the sea (before him), the great Rishi, affected with grief, tied a heavy stone to his neck and threw himself into its waters.

sa: महातेजा महावीर्यो बाल एव गुणैर्युतः। ऋचीकस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु जमदग्निस्ततोऽभवत्॥
en: His (Aurva's) son was Richika, who became, even in his boyhood, very powerful, energetic and virtuous. He (Richika) begot Jamadagni.

sa: वसिष्ठो घातिताञ्छ्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रेण तान् सुतान्। धारयामास तं शोकं महाद्रिरिव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Having learnt that his sons had been caused to be killed by Vishvamitra, Vasishtha patiently bore his grief, as the great mountain bears the earth.

sa: तस्मिन् पुरुषशार्दूले निहते भूरितेजसि। भीष्मः शान्तनवो राजा प्रेतकार्याण्यकारयत्॥
en: When that best of men, the greatly powerful prince, was killed, Bhishma the son of Shantanu performed all his obsequies.

sa: वैनतेयस्तु गरुडो बलवानरुणस्तथा। बृहस्पतिश्च भगवानादित्येष्वैव गण्यते॥
en: Vinata's son, Garuda and the Aruna also and illustrious Brihaspati were counted amongst the Adityas.

sa: दरिद्राय हि मे भार्यां को दास्यति विशेषतः। प्रतिग्रहीष्ये भिक्षां तु यदि कश्चित्प्रदास्यति॥
en: But who will give his daughter to a poor man like me to be my wife? I shall, however, accept the girl who will be given to me as gift.

sa: तस्माद् धर्मप्रधानात्मा वेदधर्मविदीप्सितः। ब्राह्मणो गुणवान् कश्चित् पुरोधाः प्रतिदृश्यताम्॥ क्षत्रियेणाभिजातेन पृथिवीं जेतुमिच्छता। पूर्वं पुरोहितः कार्यः पार्थ राज्याभिवृद्धये॥
en: O Partha, a Kshatriya of noble birth should first appoint a priest, if he is (at all) desirous of extending his dominions by conquering the earth. He, who is desirous of conquering the earth, should have a Brahmana before him.

sa: मया चैतां विप्रधर्मोक्तिसीमां मर्यादां वै स्थापितां सर्वलोके। सन्तो विप्राः शुश्रुवांसो गुरूणां देवा लोकाश्चोपशृण्वन्तु सर्वे॥६८।
en: I set this limit to the conduct of the Brahmanas everywhere. Let this (my solemn words) be heard by the honest men, by the Brahmanas, by the celestials and by those who regard their superiors."

sa: वसिष्ठ इति तस्यैतदृषेर्नाम त्वयेरितम्। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं यथावत् तद् वदस्व मे॥
en: "I desire to hear the history of the Rishi whom you have mentioned by the name of Vasishtha. Tell me all about him in detail.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् पुरे राष्ट्रे त्यक्तदारपरिग्रहाः। परस्परममर्यादाः क्षुधार्ता जजिरे जनाः॥
en: The famished people of the city and the country abandoned their wives and children and grew reckless of one another.

sa: अस्त्रेण चास्याथैन्द्रेण न्यवधीत् तुरगोत्तमान्। कन्याहेतोर्नरश्रेष्ठ भीष्मः शान्तनवस्तदा॥ जित्वा विसर्जयामास जीवन्तं नृपसत्तमम्। ततः शाल्वः स्वनगरं प्रययौ भरतर्षभ॥ स्वराज्यमन्वशाच्चैव धर्मेण नृपतिस्तदा। राजानो ये च तत्रासन् स्वयंवरदिदृक्षवः॥ स्वान्येव तेऽपि राष्ट्राणि जग्मुः परपुरंजयाः। एवं विजित्य ताः कन्या भीष्मः प्रहरतां वरः॥ प्रययौ हास्तिनपुरं यत्र राजा स कौरवः। विचित्रवीर्यो धर्मात्मा प्रशास्ति वसुधामिमाम्॥
en: The best of men, the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, for the sake of the maidens, killed the excellent steed (of his adversary) by the Aindra weapon. He then defeated that best of kings, (Shalva), but allowed him to escape with his life. O best of the Bharata race, thereupon, Shalva went away to his own kingdom. Having returned to his capital, he virtuously ruled over his people; and O subjugator of hostile towns, the kings also who came to the Svaymvara returned to their own capitals. After defeating the kings, the best of all wielders of arms, Bhishma, went with the maidens to Hastinapur, where that king of the Kurus, Vichitravirya, who ruled the world.

sa: वामादजायताङ्गुष्ठाद्भार्या तस्य महात्मनः। तस्यां पञ्चाशतं कन्याः स एवाजनयन्मुनिः॥
en: The wife of the illustrious Daksha sprang from the left toe of Brahma. He then begot fifty daughters on her.

sa: उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं तपती प्रहसन्निव। उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते न त्वमर्हस्यरिंदम्॥ मोहं नृपतिशार्दूल गन्तुमाविष्कृतः क्षितौ। एवमुक्तोऽथ नृपतिर्वाचा मधुरया गिरा॥
en: Sweetly smiling, Tapati spoke thus in sweet words, “Rise, rise, O chastiser of foes be blessed. O best of kings, you are celebrated in the word, it does not befit you to lose your senses.” Having been thus addressed by her in these sweet words,

sa: तेषाममृतवीर्याणां रसानां पयसैव च। अमरत्वं सुरा जग्मुः काञ्चनस्य च नि:स्रवात्॥
en: The celestials became immortal by drinking the water mixed with the liquid extract of gold and those gums which had the quality of the Ambrosia.

sa: ततो नारायणं देवं ब्रह्मा वचनमब्रवीत्। विधत्स्वैषां बलं विष्णो भवानत्र परायणम्॥
en: Then did Brahma say to Narayana, “Kindly give the celestials strength to churn the Ocean again with Mandara mountain, O Vishnu you are our refuge."

sa: विष्णुरुवाच बलं ददामि सर्वेषां कमैतद्ये समास्थिताः। क्षोभ्यतां कलशः सर्वैर्मन्दरः परिवर्त्यताम्॥
en: Narayana said : I grant all necessary strength for all those who are engaged in this action. Go, insert the mountain and churn the Ocean.

sa: धन्वन्तरिस्ततो देवो वपुष्मानुदतिष्ठत। श्वेतं कमण्डलुं बिभ्रदमृतं यत्र तिष्ठति॥
en: Then rose the divine Dhanvantari with a white vessel in his hand and there in that vessel) was the Ambrosia.

sa: यस्या पुत्रा महेष्वासा जज्ञिरे पञ्च पाण्डवाः। ऋतुकाले ततो ज्येष्ठां वधूं तस्मै न्ययोजयत्॥
en: This son afterwards begot those mighty bow-men, the five Pandavas. (Sometime after), when her eldest daughter-in-law was again in her season, she was asked by (Satyavati) to go to Vyasa.

sa: अमृतं ब्राह्मणा गावो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा। अपत्यं कपिलायास्तु पुराणे परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: The Ambrosia, Brahmanas, the kine the Gandharvas and Apsaras were the offspring of Kapila, so is stated in the Purana.

sa: स जज्ञे विदुरो नाम कृष्णद्वैपायनात्मजः। धृतराष्ट्रस्य वै भ्राता पाण्डोश्चैव महात्मनः॥
en: The son of Krishna Dvaipayana thus born was known by the name of Vidura. He was thus the brother of the illustrious Dhritarashtra and Pandu.

sa: नक्तं च बलमस्माकं भूय एवाभिवर्धते। यतस्ततो मां कौन्तेय सदारं मन्युराविशत्॥
en: O son of Kunti, our strength specially increases at the time of night. As I was accompanied by my wife, I was filled with wrath.

sa: एकपादेन षण्मासान् स्थितो विद्यां लभेदिमाम्। अनुनेष्याम्यहं विद्यां स्वयं तुभ्यं व्रतेऽकृते॥
en: One can acquire this (science) by standing on one leg for six months. I shall impart to you this science without your observing any vows.

sa: तं राजा सह तैश्चौरैरन्वशाद् वध्यतामिति। स रक्षिभिस्तैरज्ञात: शूले प्रोतो महातपाः॥
en: The king sentenced him along with the thieves. The guards, acting in ignorance, put the great Rishi also on the Shula (an instrument of death).

sa: क्रियमाणेषु कृत्येषु कुमाराणां महात्मनाम्। पौरजानपदाः सर्वे बभूवुः सततोत्सवाः॥
en: The citizens and the people were all filled with hope on seeing the achievements and behaviour of the youthful princes.

sa: प्रसन्ना मोक्षयेदस्मांस्तस्माच्छापाच्च भामिनी। कृष्णं पुच्छं करिष्यामस्तुरगस्य न संशयः॥
en: If she was gratified, she might free them from the curse. They said:-“We shall undoubtedly make the horse's hair black.”

sa: श्रोतुमिच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् किं पापं कृतवानसि। येनेह समनुप्राप्तं शूले दुःखभयं महत्॥
en: "O Brahmana, we desire to hear what is your sin for which you suffer this torture of being placed at the point of the Shula."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच गते भगवति व्यासे पाण्डवा हृष्टमानसाः। ते प्रतस्थुः पुरस्कृत्य मातरं पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the illustrious Vyasa went away, those best of men, the Pandavas, proceeded with joyous heart, (towards Panchala) placing their mother at the head (of the procession.)

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु पाञ्चाल्यमानीय स्वं निवेशनम्। उपाकरोदस्त्रहेतोर्भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥ अमोक्षणीयं दैवं हि भावि मत्वा महामतिः। तथा तत् कृतवान् द्रोण आत्मकीर्त्यनुरक्षणात्॥
en: Then Drona brought the Panchala prince Dhrishtadyumna to his own house and taught him all weapons as a requital of taking the half of the kingdom of Drupada. Regarding Destiny to be inevitable, the illustrious son of Bharadvaja did what would perpetuate his own deeds.

sa: यः श्रोत्रयोरमृतं संनिषिञ्चेद् विद्यामविद्यस्य यथा ममायम्। तं मन्येऽहं पितरं मातरं च तस्मै न दुह्येत् कृतमस्य जानन्॥
en: “I regard him, who pours the Ambrosia of knowledge into one's ears, as you have done to me who was devoid of knowledge, both as my father and as my mother. He who has gratitude can never injure his preceptor.

sa: यस्मात्तस्मात्सुप्रतीक हस्तित्वं समवाप्स्यसि। शप्तस्त्वेवं सुप्रतीको विभावसुमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: For this, O Supratika, you will become an elephant.” Thus being cursed Supratika told Vibhavasu,

sa: एवं मां भगवान् व्यासः पुरा पौरवन्दना प्रोवाचासुकरप्रज्ञस्तस्मादेवं चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, the illustrious and wise Vyasa formerly told me this. Therefore I am resolved upon doing it.

sa: ननादोच्चैः स बलवान्महामेघ इवाम्बरे। वध्यमानः सुरगणैः सर्वभूतानि भीषयन्॥
en: When he was attacked by the celestials, he roared in the sky, like the great cloud, frightful to every creature.

sa: शर्मिष्ठोवाच तपसा तेजसा चैव दीप्यमानं यथा रविम्। तं दृष्ट्वा मम सम्प्रष्टुं शक्तिर्नासीच्छुचिस्पिते॥
en: Sharmishtha said : O lady of sweet smiles, that Rishi was as effulgent in asceticism and energy as the sun. Seeing him, I had no power of making these enquiries.

sa: ततः कुन्ती च विप्रश्च सहितावनिलात्मजम्। तमबूतां कुरुष्वेति स तथेत्यब्रवीच्च तौ॥
en: Thereupon Kunti and the Brahmana went to the son of Anila (Bhima) and told him "Do this"; and he replied by saying “Be it so."

sa: सौतिरुवाच तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तदा। शशास शिष्यमासीनं वैशंपायनमन्तिके॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard these words of Janamejaya, Krishna Dvaipayana addressed his disciple Vaishampayana, seated by his side saying,

sa: राजानं प्रथमं विन्देत् ततो भार्यां ततो धनम्। त्रयस्य संचयेनास्य ज्ञातीन् पुत्रांश्च तारयेत्॥
en: It is said that a (good) king should be saved first, them a wife and then wealth, by the acquisition of the three, one can rescue his relatives and sons.

sa: ततः प्ररुदितान् सर्वान् निशम्याथ सुतस्तदा। उत्फुल्लनयनो बाल: कलमव्यक्तमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon seeing them all weep, their son of tender years, spoke thus in childish words, his eyes expanded with joy.

sa: तमेवंवादिनं भीष्मं प्रत्यभाषत मद्रपः। न हि मेऽन्यो वरस्त्वत्तः श्रेयानिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Bhishma, the king of Madra replied, "To my mind there is no other better bridegroom than one of your family.

sa: आत्मा पुत्रः सखा भार्या कृच्छं तु दुहिता किला स कृच्छ्रान्मोचयात्मानं मां च धर्मे नियोजय॥
en: The son is one's own self; the wife is one's friend; the daughter is (however) a source of trouble. Save yourself by sacrificing that cause of trouble; and set me on the path of virtue.

sa: व्यक्तं तद् भवतश्चापि विदितं नात्र संशयः। न च युक्तं तथा वक्तुं भवान् देहीति सत्तम॥
en: It (this custom) is well known and there is no doubt that it is also known to you. O the proper excellent man, therefore, it is not proper for you to say "Bestow your sister.”

sa: न चाप्यधर्मः कल्याण बहुपत्नीकृतां नृणाम्। स्त्रीणामधर्मः सुमहान् भर्तुः पूर्वस्य लङ्घने॥
en: To marry more than one wife is not sin among men. It is very sinful for a woman to take second husband after the first.
